dialogue.text: YO! OJ, LOOK! IS THAT RYNO?! THE ASTRAL-TIER UNAMON FROM MIST & STONE?!
It feels... big. And angry. Like a headache that's about to charge you. The ground is shaking a little.
Ma'am, please stay behind the safety line! Astral Unit #15 is not a tourist attraction! It's extremely volatile!
Wait... Unit #15... that goofy rhino I doodled in The Book... That's... that's HIM?! No way!
You... doodled the creature that's making the continent shake? PJ, what did you do?
See?! It's doing its pre-battle animation! Just like in the game! He's challenging me!
Ma'am, that is an aggression display! It's not an 'animation'!
LET'S DANCE, YA BIG BLIND CHARGER!
